name: Triple Threads
address: Sunrise Hotel Street, Les Terrace de Sahel, Block C, 3rd Floor, Sahel Aalma, Jounieh, Lebanon
headline:
Small stitches.
Big personality.
intro: Cherries, sunshine and a little seaside spirit. Explore crochet, embroidery and beadwork by a mother and her two daughters in Lebanon.
story_label: Meet the hands behind the threads
story_short: Reine Abi Hanna and her daughters Laure and Yara share a love of making. Crochet, embroidery and beading become colourful clutches, accessories and pieces for everyday life.
story_long: Triple Threads is a family project led by Reine Abi Hanna with her daughters Laure and Yara. Their craft carries forward skills Reine learned from her mother, bringing crochet, embroidery and beading into a new family chapter.
story_second: Based in Sahel Aalma, Jounieh, the makers create across a varied world of accessories and home pieces. This collection focuses on the clutches, pouches and motif pieces pictured in their public portfolio.
statement:
A cherry here. A flower there.
Little details with a personality of their own.
visit: Visits are by appointment. Contact the makers before coming.
closing_text: A colour you love, an occasion to celebrate, a motif that feels like you. Start with a photograph and share your idea.
collection_intro: Colourful crochet collections and little motifs with a playful point of view. These photographs are inspiration for a conversation with the makers.
gallery_intro: From the family behind the project to the stitches on the table. Explore the photographs and the details within them.
products: Navy stripes, cream crochet and bright red lobster motifs. Tell the makers which piece in this photograph catches your eye.
